# SCI-NOI v0.1 r0.2 Shared Normative Module: Predictions

Module identity: `SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_PREDICTIONS v0.1/r0.2`

Status: implementation-blind Stage B draft authority; content-bound by
`SCI-NOI_NORMATIVE_MODULE_BINDING v0.1/r0.2`; not owner-accepted or frozen.
These are analytic expectations of the stated contract, not reports of
implementation conformity or empirical validation.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-001` A globally complemented assignment has equal probability
under the approved complement-symmetric target-law family.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-002` Every active detector has target-law marginal sign mean
zero; under the fixed linear member equation, every available map row has
target-law member mean zero.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-003` Complement symmetry does not remove source or structured
residual contributions from individual members, conditional second moments,
or tails.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-004` Under the exact fixed member equation, globally
complementing every active sign negates `M_b` while leaving `Q_p` unchanged.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-005` Complement-related members have identical pointwise squares
and outer products even though their full-distribution identities remain
distinct.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-006` `Vhat_cond` is nonnegative wherever available and is
unavailable outside the exact common all-member domain.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-007` A source-bearing fixed component can create source-shaped
structure in `Vhat_cond`; zero target-law mean is insufficient to prevent it.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-008` Any failed admitted member makes the initial UNC ensemble
unavailable; completed survivors do not realize a partial estimator.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-009` Increasing member count may improve estimation of the
declared randomization target but cannot create astronomical exposure or
reduce the immutable parent map's realized noise as `1/sqrt(N)`.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-010` A fixed owner-defined linear transformation propagates a
conditional second moment by the fixed operator relation; a per-member learned
transformation does not satisfy that identity by implication.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-011` A positive decision under one NOI profile neither realizes
the next operation nor changes producer-owned facts.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-012` If a required response companion is unavailable, response-
dependent output is unavailable; signal membership does not silently shrink.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-013` An idempotent deterministic execution retry can change
attempt/evidence identity without changing scientific member identity; a
changed assignment or scientific state cannot.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-014` Conditional on later owner acceptance of the recommended
independent symmetric candidate law and first-accepted bounded rejection,
finite retry changes resolution probability but, conditional on success, not
the uniform distribution over admissible sign vectors.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-015` A zero-total-mass stratum cannot support an imbalance ratio;
its scientific treatment remains unavailable pending owner disposition rather
than producing a numerical zero-denominator result.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-016` No binding singleton-active-stratum feasibility or failure
prediction exists until the owner accepts its exact design treatment.

`SCI-NOI-PRED-017` `zeta_cond` has unit exactly `1` on its available domain;
dimensionlessness does not establish a pivotal, Gaussian, Student, z,
N-sigma, probability, detection, false-alarm, completeness, purity, or catalog
interpretation.
